_ayuda: Direcciones de arte para los diseños con IA (source 'diseno'). Solo se usan las de 'aprobados' (las aprobó el dueño). Las demás quedan para probar. 'reglas' se agrega siempre.
reglas: AVOID generic template design: no laurel leaves or botanical sprigs, no rows of circular icons, no pill-shaped buttons, no centered symmetrical flyer layout, no ribbons, no script or handwritten fonts, no clip-art ornaments, no stock 'luxury' cliches. Make bold, original art direction worthy of an award-winning design studio. Palette only: burgundy #811721, deep wine #5E0F17, cream #FCF1E1, beige #F3D8B9, muted gold #9C6A2B. Do not write any text at all in the image (the system adds the typography: Playfair Display and Manrope). Spanish text spelled exactly as given and nothing else written. No prices unless given, no people, nothing sexual or suggestive. Do not draw buildings, facades, rooms or interiors that could be mistaken for the hotel (only the real photo may show the hotel). Keep key content away from the top 220 px and the bottom 300 px (Instagram UI). Vertical 9:16 for Hotel Le Chateau, Providencia, Santiago.

estilos.poster-deco: Art direction: a 1920s Art Deco travel poster in the spirit of Cassandre: strong geometric composition, flat color planes, stepped frames and radiating lines, dramatic perspective. The photo area is a tall arched or stepped window cut into the poster.
estilos.cine: Art direction: an elegant film title card at night, like the opening credits of a classic movie: deep wine-black background with subtle film grain and light leaks, the photo area as a wide cinematic letterbox frame, title set like a film credit with generous letter spacing, one thin gold line.
estilos.suizo: Art direction: Swiss international typographic style with a warm twist: strict modular grid, big flush-left title, lots of negative space, one strong geometric burgundy shape, small numbered labels. The photo area is a clean rectangle aligned to the grid.
estilos.collage: Art direction: a refined paper collage: layered cut paper shapes in cream, burgundy and gold foil, subtle shadows between layers, an art-deco cut-out frame for the photo area, tactile but elegant.
estilos.noche-burdeos: Art direction: cinematic night poster. The photo area is a large full-width zone covering roughly the upper 60% of the piece, edge to edge, with a straight bottom edge (it will fade into the background). Below it, a deep burgundy-to-wine background with a soft glow. Thin gold art-deco corner ornaments framing the whole composition. Logo small at the top, in cream, over the photo area's top margin. A small tracked gold kicker, a big cream title in a tall narrow art-deco typeface, a thin gold rule with a small diamond.
